title: MV Icons in the title screen options?

posts.author: Weg
posts.body: Are there any plugins out there that would let me insert icons into the selection box on the title screen?

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
Check out
@Eliaquim
's Escape Codes plugin
Hakuen Studio Escape Codes for RPG Maker MZ by Hakuen Studio
Show almost everything from database using escape codes!
hakuenstudio.itch.io

posts.author: Eliaquim
posts.body:
I guess on your case, if you are using MV, you can try using my Global Text plugin, that allow you to insert escape codes on any window. So it would work with your example above.
It is inside the sample project:
Hakuen Studio MV Museum by Hakuen Studio
All Hakuen Studio MV Plugins! For free!
hakuenstudio.itch.io
The one
@ATT_Turan
suggested, will only implement new escape codes to use, but not necessarily in any window. But of course, Global text and Escape codes work together
